d:
Nepal ke pradhanmantri balendr shah do din ki bharat yatra par dilli aa rahe hain. march men satta sanbhalne ke bad yah unki pahli dvipakshiy videsh yatra hai. is dauran aarthik aur oorja sahyog, nae havaee galiyaron aur nepal men barh ke bad punarnirman sahayta par charcha hone ki ummid hai.
Kya shah ki yatra bharat-nepal sanbandhon men naee shuruaat kar paegi? aur kya ve bharat se thos aarthik madad hasil kar paenge?
